title: Patient-Confirmed Closure of Ended Inpatient Stays Under Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When the patient, or the parent or guardian of a minor patient, confirms the cancellation of an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Prime whose stay has ended, it is closed as cancelled that day under **Referrals and Authorizations**, and the inpatient days left on it are released.

## What the confirmation records

- The confirmed cancellation request.
- The authorization's status becomes cancelled, with today as its closing date, and its units remaining become zero.
- One release entry with the reason "cancellation" is added to its unit history for the days released.
- A cancelled authorization is never reopened.

## Invocation

The tool is `confirm_inpatient_closure_5bde1317`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, that is, the patient, or the parent or guardian of a minor patient, confirming in person.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the inpatient authorization being cancelled, as the representative read it out from the patient's referral and authorization record | identifier |
| `units_released` | the inpatient days the cancellation releases, exactly as the representative stated it | whole number, 0 or more |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `cancellation_request_id` (the reference number of the confirmed cancellation request), `release_entry_id` (the reference number of the release entry), `referral_authorization_id` (the authorization cancelled), `status` (reading "cancelled" once recorded), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `units_released` (the days released).

## Scope

The authorizations this confirmation covers are counted in inpatient days: the Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization and the Inpatient Mental Health Authorization, covered under TRICARE Prime, whose stay has ended.
